editing.objective: mean squared error to common signed one-hot targets plus ridge on weight

test_policy: Training never constructs test data. Seal all expected training artifacts before test evaluation. Final testing cannot change source, hyperparameters or selection. New revisions require a new experiment and holdout family.
cost_policy: Report actual training CPU, complete worker wall/CPU, process maximum RSS, state bytes, all selection/checkpoint/evaluation time and failures. Report energy unknown when no readable hardware counter; never infer Joules from CPU seconds.
claim_scope: Independent finite-state probability populations with learned intercell messages; synthetic disjoint source families. Finite-volume spatial and Erlang refractory approximations remain explicit. No multimodal-foundation-model claim. Width is population count, not signed-content width.
numerical_scope: Mixed precision physical state remains FP64; native32 diagnostic failed long-horizon mass gate before campaign. QVI root differentiable; finite-grid projection is piecewise differentiable with symmetric generalized derivatives at exact knots.
stopping_scope: Earliest confidence >= .8; forced final at step11; pre-late metric uses each sample late_step-1, not t0 receiver with no message.
preflight_decision: Population-normalized and raw readouts both failed the exploratory pulse-learning smoke; retain the original raw feature definition. Report this negative result and run the prespecified bounded campaign without further smoke selection.
